name: slime-calling-at-the-opponents-end-phase-activates-the-top-card-slime-for-one-less
notes: Two defects: (1) the generated look loop took deck indexes N..1, never the TOP card (and one card below the range); (2) its timing prereq was written to a table nothing consulted and compared against phase codes the engine never reports (the opponent's end-phase window runs as 'BEOP'). Both fixed (Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce / CanActivateCardForSelection now consult $cardActivatedPrereqs).

rulesClauses: Activate this card only during an opponent's end phase. [Class Bonus] Look at the top 3+LV cards of your deck. You may activate up to two Slime ally cards from among them. Cards you activate this way cost 1 less to activate.

engineBug.summary: Slime Calling never looked at the top card of the deck, and its 'only during an opponent's end phase' restriction was not enforced.
